bio_text: Prajyot Patil is an ML/Robotics Software Engineer at Meta with a background spanning manipulation, mobile robotics, and sim-to-real learning pipelines. She holds a degree from Santa Clara University and has hands-on experience with Isaac Sim, ROS 2, VSLAM, and Learning from Demonstrations frameworks including BC-GMM. Her work bridges academic research and industry application across humanoid and mobile robot platforms.
